parameters.responseBody: {"success": true, "status": "scheduled", "message": "Outside calling hours. Call will be attempted at 9am local time.", "timezone": "={{ $json.timezone }}", "scheduledAt": "={{ $json.scheduledAt }}"}

parameters.query:
SELECT
  l.id,
  l.short_id,
  l.en_title,
  l.ar_title,
  l.price,
  l.area_sqm,
  l.bedrooms,
  l.bathrooms,
  l.city,
  l.district,
  l.type,
  l.completion_status,
  l.description_en,
  l.project_id,
  p.name_en  AS project_name_en,
  p.name_ar  AS project_name_ar
FROM listings l
LEFT JOIN projects p ON l.project_id = p.id
WHERE l.id     = '{{ $('Extract & Validate Input').first().json.entityUuid }}'::uuid
  AND l.status = 'ACTIVE'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  p.id          AS project_id,
  p.name_en,
  p.name_ar,
  p.description_en,
  p.city,
  p.district,
  p.min_price,
  p.max_price,
  JSON_AGG(
    JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
      'title',             l.en_title,
      'price',             l.price,
      'area_sqm',          l.area_sqm,
      'bedrooms',          l.bedrooms,
      'bathrooms',         l.bathrooms,
      'completion_status', l.completion_status
    ) ORDER BY l.price ASC
  ) FILTER (WHERE l.id IS NOT NULL) AS layouts
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN listings l ON l.project_id = p.id AND l.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE p.id = '{{ $('Extract & Validate Input').first().json.entityUuid }}'::uuid
GROUP BY p.id, p.name_en, p.name_ar, p.description_en,
         p.city, p.district, p.min_price, p.max_price
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO crm_leads (
  source, name, phone, email, status,
  property_interest, city_preference,
  campaign_details, is_duplicate,
  created_at, updated_at
)
VALUES (
  'META_ADS',
  $$ {{ $json.leadName }} $$,
  $$ {{ $json.phone }} $$,
  NULLIF($$ {{ $json.email }} $$, ''),
  'NEW',
  $$ {{ $json.propertyName }} $$,
  $$ {{ $json.propertyCity }} $$,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'ad_type',          $$ {{ $json.adType }} $$,
    'entity_uuid',      $$ {{ $json.entityUuid }} $$,
    'property_name',    $$ {{ $json.propertyName }} $$,
    'price_range',      $$ {{ $json.priceRange }} $$,
    'country',          $$ {{ $json.country }} $$,
    'timezone',         $$ {{ $json.timezone }} $$,
    'source',           'VAPI_VOICE_QUALIFICATION',
    'call_initiated_at', NOW()::text
  ),
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_leads WHERE phone = $$ {{ $json.phone }} $$),
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

UPDATE crm_leads SET
  status = 'CONTACTED',
  campaign_details = campaign_details || jsonb_build_object(
    'vapi_call_id',     $$ {{ $json.id }} $$,
    'vapi_call_status', 'initiated',
    'call_started_at',  NOW()::text
  ),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $('Insert CRM Lead').first().json.id }}'::uuid;

UPDATE crm_leads SET
  status     = 'QUALIFIED',
  lead_score = 4,
  campaign_details = campaign_details || jsonb_build_object(
    'vapi_outcome',          'QUALIFIED',
    'vapi_summary',          $$ {{ $json.summary }} $$,
    'vapi_transcript',       $$ {{ $json.transcript }} $$,
    'vapi_recording_url',    $$ {{ $json.recordingUrl }} $$,
    'vapi_duration_seconds', {{ $json.duration }},
    'vapi_budget_mentioned', $$ {{ $json.mentionedBudget || 'not mentioned' }} $$,
    'call_completed_at',     NOW()::text
  ),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.crmLeadId }}'::uuid;

INSERT INTO crm_notes (lead_id, lead_type, agent_id, content, created_at)
VALUES (

Duration    : {{ $json.duration }}s
Budget noted: {{ $json.mentionedBudget || 'not mentioned' }}
Summary     : {{ $json.summary }}
Recording   : {{ $json.recordingUrl }} $$,
  NOW()
);
